concepts.label: server-info
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - this page's own subcommand; no promoted tool: id exists for it yet

notable_absence.finding: This is the thinnest page in the batch: its front-matter description promises 'Displays information and statistics about the Couchbase Server specified' but the DESCRIPTION body only restates 'This command prints information about the Couchbase Server specified' - dropping the word 'statistics' the page's own title uses. There is no field list, no description of what information is actually returned, and - unlike server-list.md, host-list.md and enable-developer-preview.md in this same batch, all of which show literal sample output in their EXAMPLES section - this page's EXAMPLES section shows only the invocation, never the output it produces. A reader cannot learn from this reference page what 'information and statistics' actually means.

cross_component_finding: The page's own two description strings (the front-matter 'description' attribute and the DESCRIPTION section body) are not consistent with each other - the front-matter promises 'statistics', the body promises only 'information' - a small internal inconsistency within a single, very short page, consistent with this round's terse/lightly-reviewed-prose hypothesis.
cross_product_finding: Plainly none - the page is too thin to carry any product-comparison signal.
